title: James Webb Space Telescope uncovers new clues about the origins of 'interstellar invader' comet 3I/ATLAS
caption:
The James Webb Space Telescope has peeked at the 'interstellar invader' 3I/ATLAS. By analyzing its dusty ice, scientists found it shares surprising similarities with the icy bodies at the edge of our own solar system.

Source: Space - James Webb Space Telescope uncovers new clues about the origins of 'interstellar invader' comet 3I/ATLAS
